svg.text: What each virtual adapter mode connects
VMs on the same internal network reach each other.
Nothing outside the hypervisor is reachable, in either direction.
VMs reach each other and the host operating system.
The physical LAN is not reachable.
VMs reach the LAN through the host's own address.
Nothing on the LAN can start a connection inward.
The VM appears on the LAN as a host in its own right,
with its own address, and can be reached from it.
Bridged is the mode that makes a virtual machine part of the network
you have built. It receives an address from the pod router and is
filtered, routed, and prioritized like any physical host.
